exported_project_package.description: The downloadable .zip produced by window.__exportProject(rec) (assets/app9.js): '<id>.json' (this object), '<id>-lyrics.txt' when lyrics exist, '<id>.mid' for songs, README.txt. 'My Projects' (localStorage 'sigstudio.projects', max 12) saves the record plus a '_savedAt' timestamp.

_savedAt.description: Added by saveProject (app9.js): ISO datetime to the minute, e.g. '2026-10-03 16:25'.

reproducible.description: 'Same ID + same seed always makes this exact record. Audio is synthesized live in your browser — no samples.'

seed.description: Record seed n (or null when unknown).

studio_session.description: The Studio Session 7-stage project from freshProject() in assets/app6.js, persisted in localStorage under key 'sigstudio.project.v1'. The micBuf field (recorded mic AudioBuffer) is a runtime value only and is EXCLUDED from persistence by the JSON replacer in saveProj(). Reserved ID scheme JAH-PROJECT-%07d — session projects currently carry no JAH-PROJECT ID.

beat.description: null, or the beat spec from autoProject: {prompt, genre, bpm, bars, style}.

cd.description: Stage 7 CD state: ordered track song-IDs, album title, artist name.

tracks.description: Ordered JAH-SONG-###### IDs for the CD.

fx.description: Filter/FX stack (stage 6). Each id is one of the 16 SigSynth.FX_DEFS ids; amount 0-1 defaults to 1 when omitted.

mix.description: Stage 5 console mix: the 5 bus gains (mix.schema.json).

song.description: null, or the song record (song.schema.json shape) written by window.__writeSong.

sounds.description: Stage 1 My Library keepers: sound-record IDs.

stage.description: Current stage 1-7: 1 Sounds, 2 Beat, 3 Lyrics, 4 Singing, 5 Mix/Master, 6 Filters, 7 Burn CD.

vocal.description: Stage 4 vocal state. voice: created-voice id ('nova' default), custom profile id (e.g. 'woman-light-mid'), or 'own'. backups: BACKUP_TYPES ids.

description: Studio projects. Two forms exist in code: the 7-stage Studio Session draft (studio_session) and the exported project .zip package (exported_project_package). Both are user-created, stored on the user's device only.
title: Signature Music Studio — Project
